description_en: Describes the syntax and provides examples of the ExtractFingerPrint operation
description_zh: 本文介绍指纹提取ExtractFingerPrint的语法及示例
name: ExtractFingerPrint

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the image. We recommend that you use an OSS link in the Shanghai region. For files stored locally or in OSS links outside the Shanghai region, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html.

Specify either ImageURL or ImageData. If both are specified, the URL takes precedence. For information about Base64 encoding of files, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468191.html
parameters.help_zh:
图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。

ImageURL与ImageData二选一，当URL方式与Base64编码方式共存时，URL方式优先。文件的Base64编码处理操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468191.html
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.help_en:
The Base64-encoded string of the image. For information about Base64 encoding of files, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468191.html.

Specify either ImageURL or ImageData. If both are specified, the URL takes precedence
parameters.help_zh:
图像的Base64编码字符串。文件的Base64编码处理操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468191.html。

ImageURL与ImageData二选一，当URL方式与Base64编码方式共存时，URL方式优先
parameters.name: image_data

FingerPrint.description_en: The Base64-encoded string of the fingerprint extraction result image
FingerPrint.description_zh: 指纹提取结果图像的Base64编码字符串
